text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer, you're looking rather
exhausted.
Oh dear, that won't do. I
know just the thing...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let's get dancing! Come on, now! Give
me
dynamic! Open up those joints!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's it! Faster, faster—raise the beat!
Well? I
bet that raised your heartbeat
too, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Being tired is no excuse to do
nothing—no, no.
Feeling sluggish?
Dance. Anxious? Take the dive.

Remember that!
